name: Monotonic Writes (Session Guarantee)
description: Monotonic writes session guarantee of Terry et al. (PDIS 1994): a replica applies a write from a session only after it has applied all previous writes of that same session, so writes of a session take effect in the order issued. One of the four session guarantees. Brzezinski et al. (2003) proved PRAM = read-your-writes ∧ monotonic reads ∧ monotonic writes (Viotti & Vukolić 2016, Eq. 20), so monotonic writes alone is strictly weaker than PRAM.

catSupport.note: A per-execution ordering condition on a session's writes (per-session write order respected by every replica), i.e. a cat acyclicity axiom over po and co.
